symptom: `mxcli check` reports MDL004 "return has a value but microflow does not declare a return type" on the describe output of five untouched Evora microflows (OIDC.SUB_HandlePrivateKey, TcConnector.HandleSSOLoginMicroflow, three TeamcenterToolkit ones), so exec would not re-apply them
cause: The stored model really is that way: MicroflowReturnType is DataTypes$VoidType while an EndEvent keeps a ReturnValue (Studio Pro keeps it when the return type is set to Nothing and hides the field). Describe renders it faithfully; mxbuild 10.24.15 and 11.13.0 accept it, also when exec writes it fresh
insight: Classify before relaxing: this is a real defect Studio Pro tolerates, not a check bug — the runtime does return the value, and a workflow branching on the call fails at instance start (write-workflows skill). So new code keeps the error and only a flow the project already stores with at least as many valued end events is downgraded to a warning, the 'settled' pattern MDL067 uses. Reading the BSON settled which of describer-drops-the-type vs genuinely-absent it was
